Package org.apache.poi.hssf.eventusermodel

Class FormatTrackingHSSFListener

java.lang.Object
org.apache.poi.hssf.eventusermodel.FormatTrackingHSSFListener
All Implemented Interfaces:
HSSFListener
public class FormatTrackingHSSFListener extends Object implements HSSFListener
A proxy HSSFListener that keeps track of the document formatting records, and provides an easy way to look up the format strings used by cells from their ids.

      • setUseFileFormatsForBuiltinIndexes(boolean)

    • setUseFileFormatsForBuiltinIndexes

      public void setUseFileFormatsForBuiltinIndexes(boolean useFileFormatsForBuiltinIndexes)
      Sets whether format strings for built-in format indexes are taken from the FORMAT records in the file, where the file defines them.

      Excel writes FORMAT records for some built-in indexes, and their content depends on the locale that Excel ran in (e.g. the currency formats 5-8, 42 and 44 use that locale's currency symbol). With this enabled, getFormatString(int) returns the file's format string for such indexes, as HSSFDataFormat.getFormat(short) does. It falls back to HSSFDataFormat.getBuiltinFormat(short) when the file defines nothing for the index.

      Defaults to false, which always returns the built-in format string for built-in indexes.

      Parameters:
      useFileFormatsForBuiltinIndexes - true to prefer the file's FORMAT records for built-in indexes
      Since:
      6.0.0
